answer: Each agent key must post a fresh verifiable delay function output every epoch: a sequential cipher chain seeded by the epoch beacon, roughly ten minutes of unparallelizable squaring that anyone can verify in milliseconds. An honest agent pays that once per epoch; a farm of 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 cores running in lockstep, since extra hardware cannot speed up a single chain. There is no precompute oasis because the seed is new each epoch, and ivory ASIC speedups shrink the cost per key but never let one chain serve many keys.
